description: Reference decision cases for the Betsee Cedar policies. Each case is one ActionRequest (or session.create) against the Acme Logistics seed; expect is the Betsee decision after composition (docs/security/adr-0001-policy-engine-cedar.md). Tiers: 0 public, 1 internal, 2 confidential, 3 restricted. Owner: security-architect.
